---
title: "Bashisms vs POSIX Shell Features"
---

# Bashisms vs POSIX Shell Features

| Feature | GNU Bash | POSIX sh (/bin/sh) |
|---------|----------|-------------------|
| Test syntax | `[[ $a == $b ]]` | `[ "$a" = "$b" ]` |
| Arrays | `arr=(a b)` | None (use `$@` or IFS) |
| String replacement | `${var//find/replace}` | `echo "$var" \| sed 's/find/replace/g'` |
| Function keyword | `function myfunc() { }` | `myfunc() { }` |
| Local variables | `local x=1` | Not standard POSIX (widely supported) |
| Regex match | `[[ $v =~ pattern ]]` | Use `expr` or `grep` |

Audit scripts for accidental bashisms using `checkbashisms script.sh`.
